scope: One Oct 25 published video (dab-video-2026-10-25-agent-skills), ten reader/search/feed/feedback routes only. Preserve six articles, two podcasts, other video, six image-job bindings, accepted PNGs, prior historical pages and schedule.

old.title: Reimagine business productivity with AI agents and assistants
old.summary: IBM AI Academy instructor Parul Mishra explains the difference between a human-directed AI assistant and an agent capable of carrying out workflows. The 7:58 lesson examines how both can improve employee productivity and how teams should decide which type of assistance fits a business task. This is an evergreen March 2025 instructional overview.
old.why_it_matters: Knowledge workers can avoid confusing fluent chat with delegated autonomy by mapping a real workflow and identifying which steps need assistance, which merit permitted automation and where human review remains essential.

new.title: Putting AI to work for talent
new.summary: IBM AI Academy instructor Kim Morick explains how generative AI can help HR teams improve recruiting, employee skill development and daily service workflows. The 8:16 lesson shows practical ways AI may improve employee experiences and reduce administrative work while people retain responsibility for decisions. This is an evergreen May 2024 instructional episode, not an October 2026 launch.
new.why_it_matters: Choose a recurring employee-support or recruiting task, assess sensitive data and human-review needs, then pilot AI assistance with measurable quality, time and employee-experience outcomes. Preserve human judgment on hiring and other consequential decisions.
new.learning_objective: Identify practical generative-AI uses in HR and talent workflows, including recruiting, skill development and employee experience.
new.practical_action: Select one routine employee-service workflow, document the expected outcome, approvals and protected employee data, then evaluate pilot quality and time saved.
transferrable_takeaways: Start with specific low-risk HR workflows, not fully autonomous employment decisions.
Use AI to augment employee development and staff service while preserving accountable human decisions.
Measure process-quality and employee-experience changes, not just automated activity counts.
new.original_episode_date_basis: IBM publisher's May 1, 2024 roundup introduces the AI Academy talent episode
